pumi.harness.v1.Capabilities.Network.jso.description: Network is the network access of a run.

hosts.description: The hosts, when the access is ACCESS_HOSTS.

pumi.harness.v1.Capabilities.Network.jso.title: Network

pumi.harness.v1.Capabilities.jsonschema..description:
Capabilities is the capability list of an invocation (decision 0159),
 neutral between harnesses. What the list leaves out, the run may not do.

^(write_paths)$.description:
The paths the run may write, as globs relative to the workspace. A file
 written outside them fails the invocation.

commands.description:
The commands the run may run, as prefixes such as "go test". An entry
 may begin with one or more NAME=value assignments, such as
 "GOWORK=off go test", and then allows that command with exactly those
 assignments: the entry "go test" does not allow "GOWORK=off go test",
 and no entry allows an assignment it does not name. Each adapter
 translates an entry as written (decision 0248).

tools.description: The kinds of tool the run may use.

writePaths.description:
The paths the run may write, as globs relative to the workspace. A file
 written outside them fails the invocation.

pumi.harness.v1.Capabilities.jsonschema..title: Capabilities

pumi.harness.v1.Component.jsonschema.jso.description:
Component is the component that an invocation runs, with its name and
 version (decision 0024).
pumi.harness.v1.Component.jsonschema.jso.title: Component

pumi.harness.v1.Gateway.jsonschema.json.description: Gateway is how the adapter reaches the model gateway (decision 0036).

^(keeps_sign_in)$.description:
Whether the harness keeps its own sign-in, such as a Claude
 subscription. When it does, the gateway forwards the harness's own
 credential, and the harness sends the token in the header X-Pumi-Token
 on every call. When it does not, the gateway holds the provider's API
 key, and the harness sends the token as its API key (decision 0225).

keepsSignIn.description:
Whether the harness keeps its own sign-in, such as a Claude
 subscription. When it does, the gateway forwards the harness's own
 credential, and the harness sends the token in the header X-Pumi-Token
 on every call. When it does not, the gateway holds the provider's API
 key, and the harness sends the token as its API key (decision 0225).

token.description:
The short-lived token, valid for this invocation only. The runner masks
 it in the log.

pumi.harness.v1.Gateway.jsonschema.json.title: Gateway

pumi.harness.v1.Input.jsonschema.json.description: Input is the input of an invocation (decision 0024).

task.description: The task, such as the prompt of an agent run.

pumi.harness.v1.Input.jsonschema.json.title: Input

pumi.harness.v1.Invocation.jsonschema.js.description:
Invocation is what the runner gives a harness adapter. The runner derives
 it from the invocation document (pumi.runner.v1.Invocation, decision
 0024): it leaves out what only the runner needs, which is the credential
 handles, the image digest and the isolation level, and adds what it has
 resolved, which is the workspace, the model gateway and the output schema
 (decision 0158). An agent run always has the model gateway (decision
 0226). An adapter never receives a credential handle or a provider key.

^(model_role)$.description:
The model role of an agent run, such as "frontier". The adapter asks
 its harness for the role by name, as the model of its calls, and the
 model gateway sends each call to the model that the configuration maps
 the role to (decision 0233).

^(output_schema)$.description: The schema of the structured output.

budget.description:
The budget. The model gateway's caps enforce its tokens and cost, and
 the runner its seconds; the adapter can also pass it to its harness
 (decisions 0193 and 0228).

capabilities.description:
What the run may do. The adapter translates the list into its harness's
 own settings; the runner checks the workspace after the run (decision
 0159).

component.description: The component that the invocation runs.

gateway.description:
The model gateway, through which every model call goes (decision 0036).
 An agent run always has it; the runner refuses one without it (decision
 0226). A check or an external action has none.

input.description:
The input: the repository and tree that the workspace holds, and the
 task.

modelRole.description:
The model role of an agent run, such as "frontier". The adapter asks
 its harness for the role by name, as the model of its calls, and the
 model gateway sends each call to the model that the configuration maps
 the role to (decision 0233).

outputSchema.description: The schema of the structured output.

workspace.description:
The absolute path of the workspace, a checkout of the input tree, in
 which the runner started the adapter.

pumi.harness.v1.Invocation.jsonschema.js.title: Invocation

pumi.harness.v1.OutputSchema.jsonschema..description:
OutputSchema is the schema of an invocation's structured output (decision
 0160).

^(json_schema)$.description:
The JSON Schema generated from the message by make generate, for
 harnesses that take JSON Schema.

jsonSchema.description:
The JSON Schema generated from the message by make generate, for
 harnesses that take JSON Schema.

message.description:
The full name of the protobuf message in the api module, such as
 pumi.events.v1.VerdictRecorded. The runner parses the output into it
 with protojson, and an unknown field fails the invocation.

pumi.harness.v1.OutputSchema.jsonschema..title: Output Schema

pumi.harness.v1.Usage.jsonschema.json.description:
Usage is an amount of usage: of a budget, or what a run used (decision
 0136).
pumi.harness.v1.Usage.jsonschema.json.title: Usage
